key_assumptions.input: Starting free cash flow per share
key_assumptions.source: FY2025 diluted EPS $3.15 on ~257M shares; net income $810M (10-K XBRL). Regulated utility owner earnings recovered through authorized ROE and rate-base growth.
Execute renewables/gas/storage plan; data-center load ramps; dividend grows ~5%
10-K Liquidity and Capital Resources (+5% vs $2.03 FY2025)

open_questions: IPL retail electric base-rate moratorium through September 2029: confirm no hidden earnings drag in quarterly updates.
Data-center customer rate design and interconnection timing: monitor 8-K and Q filings.
Spot price **$75.70** and synthesis IRR **5.47%** confirmed post-refresh.
thesis: Alliant Energy is a regulated electric and natural gas utility holding company serving Iowa and Wisconsin through Interstate Power and Light (IPL) and Wisconsin Power and Light (WPL). **[Fact]** Consolidated revenues were **$4.36 billion** in fiscal 2025, up from **$3.98 billion** in 2024 (`investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260220_rpt20251231_acc0000352541_26_000007.htm`, XBRL). **[Fact]** The company earns returns authorized by state regulators on rate-base capital invested in generation, transmission, distribution, and gas infrastructure. **[Fact]** FY2025 net income was **$810 million** and diluted earnings per share were **$3.15** on roughly **257 million** shares. **[Fact]** Management targets a **$2.14** annual dividend per share in 2026, a **5%** increase from the **$2.03** paid in 2025. **[Fact]** A **$12.4 billion** construction and acquisition plan for 2026 through 2029 is focused on renewables, energy storage, dispatchable gas, and grid hardening to serve growing load, including data centers under executed electric service agreements.
why_market_wrong: The stock trades like a bond-proxy utility: investors buy the **2.8%** dividend yield at **$75.70** and credit quality, not a growth franchise. **[Inference]** That framing may underprice the rate-base growth embedded in **$3.1 billion+** annual capital spending and data-center interconnection agreements disclosed in the 10-K. **[Inference]** Conversely, the market may be right that the **IPL retail electric base-rate moratorium** through September 2029 caps near-term Iowa earnings acceleration even as capital spending rises. **[Opinion]** There is no dated mispricing catalyst; the edge, if any, is patience on a regulated compounding path at a full (not cheap) price.
